AddMTInterveneWord.description_en: Adds the source text and target text to be intervened to the dataset corresponding to the specified ProjectId and PackageId
AddMTInterveneWord.description_zh: 把待干预的原文和译文添加到ProjectId和PackageId对应的dataSet上

GetPredictDoc.description_en: Retrieves the prediction result of a document based on the docId returned by PredictMTModelByDoc
GetPredictDoc.description_zh: 根据调用PredictMTModelByDoc返回的docId，调用该接口，返回预测后的结果

PredictMTModelByDoc.description_en: Uploads document content and uses a specified model for prediction
PredictMTModelByDoc.description_zh: 上传文档内容，指定模型进行预测
